pr_title: feat: Implement general array equality checks
pr_body:
Closes #16698.

This implements general array equality checks for all array types except `Union` and `Map`.

This makes checking equality in tests a lot easier as well as just removing limitations for expressions.
pr_comments: I was a bit too enthousiastic with enabling all Nested d-types for parametric tests. The CI should succeed now.

issue_context.title: Support equality operation on nested Array types
issue_context.body:
### Description

This is currently not supported:

```python
import polars as pl

s = pl.Series(dtype=pl.Array(pl.Int8, (1, 1)))
result = s.eq(s)
```
```
pyo3_runtime.PanicException: not yet implemented: Comparison of Arrays with FixedSizeList are not yet supported
```

We have to be able to support equality operations for all our data types, otherwise we cannot test them properly.

review_comments: @coastalwhite I hope I'm not missing anything obvious here but shouldn't this be `!=` instead of `==`? Currently `tot_ne_kernel` has the same definition as `tot_eq_kernel`
Yup that is a mistake :sweat:. I will file a follow-up PR
For a future optimization, we could do the equality kernel on the whole value array first and then do a bitcount at this point.
I am not sure if that is always possible, because of `null` elements that can take up more than `0` elements in the list.
